text:
Iko Mbaụwa FIFA nke ise ka emere na Switzerland site na 16 June ruo 4 July 1954, gbasara n’obodo isii ndị ọbịa n’oge mgbe agha gasịrị nke dị n’etiti amateurism na egwuregwu ọkachamara n’oge mbụ. Ndị otu iri na isii ka e kewara n’ime otu anọ nke anọ n’okpuru usoro pụrụ iche: n’ime otu ọ bụla, akụkụ abụọ a kpọrọ aha na-egwu naanị ndị abụọ na-enweghị aha, ndị a kpọrọ aha ezuteghị onwe ha, na egwuregwu otu ọ bụla e mere ka ọ gaa n’oge mgbakwunye. Ndị abụọ kacha elu site na otu ọ bụla gara n’ihu na usoro ịkụ aka nke quarter-finals, semi-finals, egwuregwu ebe nke atọ na nke ikpeazụ.

Asọmpi ahụ ghọrọ nke kacha akara goolu n’akụkọ Iko Mbaụwa site n’ọnụọgụgụ, na goolu 140 n’ime egwuregwu 26, ihe dị ka 5.38 kwa egwuregwu. Egwuregwu ya kacha pụta ìhè bụ quarter-final Austria-Switzerland, nke Austria meriri 7-5, ebe goolu 12 jikọtara ọnụ ka bụ ndekọ maka otu egwuregwu Iko Mbaụwa. Ndị otu Hungary a na-akpọ ‘Golden Team’, ndị Mighty Magyars, bịarutere n’usoro ogologo na-enweghị mmeri ma gosipụta ịhụ ha n’anya site n’ịkụ West Germany 8-3 mgbe ha zutere n’oge otu. Sandor Kocsis nke Hungary mechara bụrụ onye kacha akara goolu n’asọmpi ahụ na goolu 11.

Ha zutere ọzọ n’ikpeazụ na Wankdorf Stadium na Bern, n’ihu igwe mmadụ e kwuru na ọ dị ihe dị ka 60,000. Ferenc Puskas, na-agbake site na mmerụ ahụ, laghachiri imepe akara mgbe nkeji isii gasịrị, ebe Zoltan Czibor mere ya 2-0 n’ime nkeji asatọ. Ma West Germany gbakwara azụ ngwa ngwa site na Max Morlock na nkeji nke 10 na Helmut Rahn na nkeji nke 18. Ka egwuregwu ahụ hà nhata, Rahn doziri ya na nkeji nke 84 iji mee ya 3-2; ‘nha anya’ Puskas nke ikpeazụ ka a gbochiri maka offside n’okwu a na-arụrịta ụka. Nsonaazụ ahụ, ihe ijuanya n’elu ndị Hungary a na-akwado nke ukwuu, ghọrọ ihe a maara dị ka ‘Miracle of Bern’ ma nye West Germany aha mbaụwa mbụ ya. Austria mechara nke atọ ebe Uruguay nke anọ. Asọmpi 1954 bụkwa Iko Mbaụwa mbụ a na-agbasa na telivishọn. Ọ nweghị onyinye onye ọkpụkpọ kacha mma n’ọchịchị maka asọmpi ahụ.
